title: Principal Java Developer - Distributed Systems, Serverless - Elasticsearch
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What Is The Role:
We are on the lookout for a Principal Software Engineer to join our Elasticsearch - Distributed Systems team and focus on how Elasticsearch provides scale, performance, and resilience, especially in the context of our Serverless offering. You will be tackling deep distributed systems challenges in how nodes in an Elasticsearch cluster communicate, and how data are indexed, allocated, and managed across nodes.
What You Will Be Doing:
• Leveraging your deep distributed systems expertise to design, build, and operate core pieces of our next-generation Serverless Elasticsearch offering, directly impacting the experience of customers worldwide.
• Improving Elasticsearch’s components that support concurrent and consistent indexing across multiple machines.
• Maintaining our cluster coordination system to keep performance high even though nodes come and go from the cluster and data moves around, while maintaining the safety and liveness properties of the system as a whole.
• Pushing the limits on the number of shards, nodes, and petabytes that Elasticsearch can handle today.
• Looking into all kinds of issues, including performance or concurrency issues, and proposing solutions.
• Supporting our support engineers with the harder problems.
• Owning operational investigations end-to-end, until performance or stability issues are successfully resolved.
What You Bring:
• You have a deep background in distributed systems and consensus algorithms.
• You have strong skills in core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as newer language features.
• You have a deep technical proficiency in algorithms.
• You have experience building large-scale distributed systems, rather than making use of off-the-shelf services.
• You have experience building and debugging complex features with a broad impact, running on multiple machines.
• You are able to own projects from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with others to develop needed components.
• You have experience managing projects involving multiple engineers.
• You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
• You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities
• You can work autonomously, drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.
Bonus Points:
• Data stores
• Search, analytics, Lucene
• Strong knowledge of the JDK
• Asynchronous event-driven network frameworks such as Netty
Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component. The typical starting salary range for new hires in this role is listed below.
These ranges represent the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the ranges may be modified in the future.
An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.
Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. Therefore, in addition to cash compensation, this role is currently eligible to participate in Elastic's stock program. Our total rewards package also includes a company-matched Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings, along with a range of other benefits offered with a holistic emphasis on employee well-being.
The typical starting salary range for this role is:
$128,300 — $203,000 CAD
Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
• Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
• Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
• Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
• Generous number of vacation days each year
• Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
• Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
• Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

title: Senior Software Engineer (.NET Ecosystem)
locationText: Berlin | Poland | Portugal | France | Spain | London | Germany | Italy | Israel | The Netherlands | Germany
locationEvidence: Berlin | Poland | Portugal | France | Spain | London | Germany | Italy | Israel | The Netherlands | Germany
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Integrations Ecosystem org builds the drivers, SDKs, connectors and BI integrations that make ClickHouse feel native in any stack. The Language Clients team maintains the official clients for Python, JavaScript, Java, Go, Rust, C++ and C#, plus the ODBC, JDBC and ADBC drivers. We're small, senior and remote across North America and EMEA. Each client has a primary owner, but no client belongs to one person: we review and co-maintain across languages and decide cross-client questions together.


THE ROLE

We're looking for a product-minded engineer to own the ClickHouse .NET client. You'll decide what the client should do by talking to the developers who use it, reading the issues and the telemetry, and listening to the community. Then you'll build it, with deep .NET expertise, and measure whether it worked. Your scope is the SDK and what builds on it: ADO.NET http://ADO.NET, Dapper and Entity Framework Core users, and the tools and integrations that depend on your client.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Know who uses the client and what they're trying to do. Define what good looks like (time to first query, error clarity, adoption by key integrations), measure it, and let that drive the roadmap.

 - Be the voice of ClickHouse for .NET developers. Speak at .NET conferences and meet-ups, and write the posts, tutorials and samples that developers and AI assistants find when they search for how to use ClickHouse from .NET (SEO and GEO). Answer questions where the community asks them.

 - Own the .NET client and its ecosystem: the client, the EF Core provider and ORM integrations, NuGet releases and support. Evolve it without breaking the people who depend on it.

 - Review and co-maintain other clients, and take part in cross-client decisions on types, errors and protocol features.

 - Bring what .NET and Windows users need to the ODBC driver, since that's how many Windows and BI tools reach ClickHouse. If you write C++, contribute to it directly.

 - Bring written proposals about where we invest next. You set direction rather than wait for it.

 - Make the client enterprise-ready: TLS and certificate handling, authentication including Microsoft Entra ID, safe credential handling, signed and reproducible packages, and the audit and compliance questions large .NET shops ask before they adopt.

 - Shape the client for agents as users: an API, docs and error messages an AI coding agent can use correctly on the first try.

 - Extend our AI development platform, with new workflows for maintaining the clients: consistency checks across languages, issue triage, release checks.


ABOUT YOU

 - Product-minded. You decide what to build from user evidence, measure whether it worked, and can explain what you chose not to build.

 - 5+ years in software, much of it on data-intensive systems: drivers, SDKs, data access, ingestion or analytics.

 - Deep C# and .NET expertise: memory management, async and the TPL, Span and pooling, profiling and benchmarking. You reason about throughput and latency down to allocations and bytes on the wire, and you prove it with tests and benchmarks.

 - Fluent in C#, and productive in at least one more of our client languages (Python, JavaScript, Java, Go, Rust, C++). You'll review and co-own across clients, not only .NET.

 - You've built or substantially extended a library other engineers depend on, and shipped NuGet packages across .NET Framework and modern .NET. You treat breaking changes accordingly.

 - Fluent in .NET data access (ADO.NET http://ADO.NET, Dapper, EF Core) and at home in the wider .NET ecosystem: ASP.NET http://ASP.NET Core, Aspire, NuGet.

 - Security-minded. You've shipped a library into enterprise environments and know what security, compliance and procurement teams look for in a dependency.

 - Enthusiastic about working in public. You've given talks or written technical content, or you're keen to, and you see it as part of the job rather than a distraction from it.

 - Thoughtful use of AI development tools, with the judgment to review what comes out.

 - Clear writing. Most coordination happens in design docs, PRs and RFCs.


NICE TO HAVE

 - ClickHouse, especially its type system, or another OLAP engine.

 - C++ and ODBC driver internals.

 - Building or maintaining an ADO.NET http://ADO.NET or EF Core provider.

 - Open-source contributions to .NET or data infrastructure.

 - Experience designing SDKs, docs or error messages with AI coding agents as the consumer.

 - Protocol or wire-format work on a database driver or network client.


LEARN MORE

 - Introducing the (blazing fast!) native TCP client for .NET https://clickhouse.com/blog/introducing-the-blazing-fast-native-tcp-client-for-net: zero-copy columnar reads, 1.5 to 2x faster than HTTP, over 99% fewer GC allocations (Oct 2026)

 - What's new in the ClickHouse .NET Driver: the road from 1.0 to 1.3 https://clickhouse.com/blog/whats-new-clickhouse-net-driver-10-to-13 (Aug 2026)

 - Meet GroeneAI: our autonomous contributor to ClickHouse https://clickhouse.com/blog/meet-groeneai-our-autonomous-contributor-to-clickhouse (Oct 2026)

 - Building a .NET API Gateway with ClickHouse and Aspire https://clickhouse.com/blog/dotnet-api-gateway-aspire (Jun 2026)

 - The .NET client on GitHub https://github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-cs and its documentation https://clickhouse.com/docs/integrations/csharp

 - ClickHouse Workload for Microsoft Fabric, now in public preview https://clickhouse.com/blog/clickhouse-for-microsoft-fabric (Sep 2026)


PERKS

 - Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

 - Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

 - Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

 - Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

 - A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

title: Chief of Staff - ComparaJa
description:
Are you ready to thrive in a dynamic and exhilarating environment, where you'll be entrusted with significant responsibilities? Are you seeking to join an extraordinary team of young, motivated, and highly ambitious individuals? If you have a genuine passion for connecting with people and driving remarkable outcomes, then you could be the perfect fit for our Chief of Staff position.
About us
We are on a mission to help consumers save time and money by matching them with the best products for their needs with banking, insurance and utilities. ComparaJa is part of Samlino Group ( https://samlinogroup.com/ ). Operating across three markets, we empowered over 10 million users last year alone, propelling them toward living healthier financial lives.
What we offer you
As our Chief of Staff you get the unique opportunity of being a key driver of our exponential growth curve. You’ll be working in-person in the HQ in Lisbon where you will constantly be pushed out of your comfort zone. To ensure a never ending growth curve, we provide you with:
• The chance to create a genuine impact - experience the thrill of working in a fast-paced environment where your efforts and results are tangible, shaping the destiny of our business.
• Inspiration and guidance - work closely with our high-performing team, alongside our international peers and founder.
• Unlimited growth potential in our company - we firmly believe in nurturing talent from within, fostering an environment where the sky's the limit.
• The passport to adventure - become part of an international organization, allowing you to spread your wings and learn from our other markets.
• Invaluable transferable skills - fuel your interpersonal, digital, entrepreneurial, organizational, project management, and business prowess through hands-on experience and cutting-edge training.
Your Responsibilities
Responsibilities in this job will be defined as we work together throughout the recruitment process however, they will be mostly centered around:
• Unleashing your progressive thinking to deliver our core mission through a wide range of innovative products and service offerings.
• Inspiring, leading, and cultivating A+ teams, empowering them to reach their potential and provide 5-star experiences to our invaluable users and partners.
• Amplifying our brand's presence in the market and architecting a best-in-class user experience.
• Defining our strategy and securing flawless execution with precision.
• Encouraging audacious dreams and pursuing them relentlessly!
What we expect from you
We are looking for experienced business managers to help us reach our objectives. Industry experience is not a requirement, but you do need to be highly ambitious, proactive, forward-thinking, a fast learner, and driven to inspire and lead our team.
Furthermore, we are looking for candidates who:
• Possess an unwavering drive and desire to be the very best at what they do.
• Exude an unparalleled work ethic, fueled by an urgency to progress.
• Embrace ownership and proactively following through on commitments.
• Possess an insatiable curiosity about business, data, and people, relishing the opportunity to build and nurture relationships that fuel lasting success.
• Master the art of communication, wielding their words with impact both verbally and in writing.
• Showcase unrivalled organizational skills, skillfully structuring and prioritizing their work to achieve maximum efficiency.
• Have full proficiency in Portuguese and work permit is required.
Start date and schedule
Flexible start date.
Monday to Friday, we thrive in our office environment, where we create magic. Remote work options are currently unavailable, as we believe in the power of collaboration and synergy that arises from working together.

title: Principal Database Engineer
locationText: United Kingdom | Brazil | United Arab Emirates | Ireland | Peru | Sweden | Colombia | Argentina | Romania | Cyprus | Switzerland | Portugal | Lithuania | South Africa | Czech Republic | Canada | Hungary | Mexico | Chile | Poland | Spain | Bulgaria | United Kingdom
description:
BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE


Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout,  xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.




THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken’s Core Infrastructure Engineering team builds and operates the shared data systems behind critical production services. Our estate spans on-premises and cloud infrastructure, with MariaDB at its centre and Kafka, Redis and Elasticsearch across the wider platform.

We’re hiring a Principal Database Engineer to bring long-term experience and technical judgment to this estate. You’ll assess it, set the goals and direction, and work hands-on with the team to deliver measurable improvements. This is an individual contributor role with influence across teams and several quarters of work.

 


THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Review the estate against business needs and production evidence. Judge reliability, scale, cost and operational complexity, identifying what should be preserved and where investment or simplification would make a difference.

 - Define the target architecture and measurable goals. Agree a prioritised roadmap with engineering leads and dependent teams, explaining the trade-offs and sequencing work around delivery risks.

 - Execute that roadmap with the team through design, implementation and adoption. Stay personally involved in difficult migrations and scaling decisions, with representative benchmarks, data-integrity checks and credible cutover and rollback plans. Adapt the plan as evidence changes and verify the results in production before calling the work complete.

 - Investigate difficult MariaDB failures and performance limits through the engine, storage and application behaviour. Improve fleet reliability through useful observability, safer changes and tested backup, restore and disaster recovery procedures. Set recovery objectives with service owners and prove them through exercises.

 - Build and maintain production software for database provisioning, upgrades and routine maintenance. Make self-service workflows safe and auditable, incorporating access controls and change evidence with Security and Compliance.

 - Work with application teams on schemas, transaction boundaries, queries and data-store choices. Make the operational consequences clear and resolve dependencies that span teams.

 - Mentor engineers across the team through design reviews, pairing and incident analysis. Help them deepen their database expertise and take ownership of technical decisions.

 - Participate in on-call and incident response, leaving clear operational ownership and following through on lessons from production.

 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 8+ years operating and evolving production database estates at scale. You have assessed inherited systems, set technical direction and delivered improvements with engineering teams, and can explain how those decisions held up over time.

 - Strong understanding of high availability, replication and distributed database failure modes. You can explain consistency and availability trade-offs and reason about transaction boundaries and reliable event delivery, including transactional outbox patterns.

 - Deep, recent hands-on MariaDB expertise, including InnoDB, MVCC and transaction isolation, locking, query optimisation, binary logs and MariaDB GTID replication. You can explain the mechanisms and diagnostic evidence behind your decisions.

 - Personal ownership of MariaDB incident diagnosis, performance tuning and tested restore or point-in-time recovery. You can explain what you did, how you established data integrity and what remained uncertain.

 - Strong software engineering skills in Python, Go, Rust or a comparable language. You have personally built and maintained production software or automation for database workflows such as provisioning, failover, online schema changes and self-service operations, using version control, code review and delivery pipelines, with tested failure handling.

 - Strong low-level Linux, Kernel, storage and networking fundamentals, with the ability to investigate problems beyond the database process.

 - Clear written technical judgment and demonstrated delivery across teams without reporting-line authority. You help stakeholders make sound database design and lifecycle decisions, and develop experienced engineers through shared delivery.

 


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience operating databases in containerised, hybrid on-premises/cloud or multi-region environments. Familiarity with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code or GitOps, including their operational trade-offs.

 - Experience with database proxies or load-balancing layers (MaxScale, HAProxy, ProxySQL, or similar).

 - Experience with PostgreSQL, Vitess, TiDB, ScyllaDB, ClickHouse or internal database platforms; operational knowledge of Kafka, Redis/Valkey or Elasticsearch/OpenSearch.

 - Experience in regulated environments or contributions to database engines, operators and other infrastructure software.



Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.




OUR COMMITMENT

title: Senior Product Architect
description:
Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.
Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.
WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU
You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:
• Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)
• Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding
• Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays
• Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material
• The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers
• As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules
• An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals
JOB SUMMARY
• You will own the overall technical architecture, platform vision, and system scalability behind Storyblok's product offerings, ensuring high performance, security, and developer joy across all systems.
• You will partner closely with product managers, engineering leads, and platform teams to design scalable cloud-native architectures, establish guardrails, and guide technical direction for enterprise-grade features.
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS
• Define and drive the long-term technical product architecture, system design, and platform scalability strategies across cloud infrastructure and microservices.
• Establish architectural guardrails, design patterns, and standards to empower engineering teams to build safe, high-performing, and resilient features.
• Lead architectural reviews for major product features, ensuring compliance with security, reliability, latency, and cost-efficiency requirements.
• Collaborate with Product, Security, DevOps, and Data teams to align product capabilities with platform performance and business goals.
EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
• 7+ years of experience in software architecture, principal engineering, or system design roles for large-scale distributed cloud applications.
• Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking
PROFESSIONAL COMPETENCIES
• Deep expertise in cloud-native architectures (AWS preferred), API design, distributed systems, and multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
• Strong fluency in modern programming backend/frontend ecosystems and microservice communication patterns.
• Proven ability to lead technical strategy and communicate complex architectural trade-offs across engineering and executive leadership.
MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS
Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space
GENERAL TERMS
Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. You can find more information about our privacy policy here .
All communications regarding job opportunities at Storyblok will come from an official Storyblok employee with an email address ending in @storyblok.com. We will never redirect you to another portal or another site that is unrelated to our domain ( storyblok.com ).

title: Manager, Documentation Engineering
locationText: Europe | France | United Kingdom | Spain | The Netherlands | European Union
description:
ClickHouse is an open-source company building the fastest and most resource-efficient real-time data platform. Our documentation is a core part of how users learn, adopt, and succeed with ClickHouse.

Our Docs team is deeply technical, independently able to use our products, read source code, test behavior, and write accurate, high-quality documentation from scratch. The team also enables contributions from across the organization and open-source community, ensuring the documentation remains consistent, discoverable, and trustworthy.

Beyond the content, the Docs team owns the documentation infrastructure as a critical, production-facing service. Its availability, performance, and reliability directly affect our users' ability to work with ClickHouse. The team is responsible for building, operating, and continuously improving this experience.

We're looking for a Documentation Engineering Manager to lead this work. This is a hands-on player-coach role for someone who can lead a small, highly technical team while contributing directly to both technical documentation and the engineering of the documentation website and its supporting infrastructure.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead the execution, development, and prioritization of the Docs Engineering team while remaining hands-on in both technical writing and engineering.

 - Own the reliability, availability, performance, and technical evolution of the ClickHouse documentation website, treating it as a critical part of the product experience.

 - Research, develop, and write technical documentation directly, including independently understanding product functionality through source code, experimentation, testing, and collaboration with Engineering and Product, rather than relying on others to provide initial drafts.

 - Define and execute documentation strategy in partnership with Engineering, Product, Product Marketing, Learning, Support, Growth, and the open-source community.

 - Improve docs-as-code contribution workflows so that engineers, product managers, the Docs team, and external contributors can create and maintain excellent documentation efficiently.

 - Review documentation pull requests, triage issues, unblock contributors, and directly author or substantially improve high-impact content.

 - Build and maintain the documentation site's infrastructure, publishing systems, automation, CI workflows, monitoring, and quality checks.

 - Establish organization-wide workflows, safeguards, and quality standards for documentation generated or maintained with AI agents.

 - Work directly with teams across ClickHouse to understand their needs, translate them into practical documentation processes, coach authors, and resolve competing priorities.

 - Ensure documentation remains accurate, comprehensive, discoverable, and aligned with the pace of product development.

 - Make documentation a driver of product adoption and growth, helping users discover ClickHouse, get started quickly, and convert into active users through an intuitive, frictionless documentation experience.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Prior experience managing and developing a technical team.

 - A hands-on leader who is comfortable moving between people management, technical writing, software engineering, process design, and day-to-day execution.

 - Strong technical writing skills and experience independently producing documentation for complex software products, including the ability to investigate functionality, read and understand source code, validate product behavior, and translate findings into clear, accurate documentation for developers.

 - Experience building, maintaining, and operating production websites, with a strong understanding of reliability, availability, performance, monitoring, and operational best practices.

 - Strong experience with documentation-as-code workflows and modern software-development practices.

 - Comfort working with Astro, TypeScript/JavaScript, GitHub Actions, pull-request workflows, and CI pipelines.

 - Experience designing or operating content quality systems, automation, and contributor workflows at scale.

 - Experience working productively with coding agents and a thoughtful point of view on applying AI to documentation without sacrificing accuracy, consistency, or trust.

 - Excellent cross-functional communication skills and the ability to draw out requirements, influence technical and product partners, set clear standards, and make progress in ambiguous situations.

 - Comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-expectation environment.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with ClickHouse or similar database technologies.

 - Experience contributing to or maintaining an open-source project.


PERKS

 - Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

 - Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

 - Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

 - Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

 - A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

 - Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.


CULTURE - WE ALL SHAPE IT

BVNK is the stablecoin-powered financial stack for enterprises. We're now part of Mastercard, and together we're building a network for every form of money – one that delivers more reach, more capability and more choice.

Trusted by industry leaders like Corpay, Worldpay, Deel, and Flywire, we deliver the infrastructure that makes new forms of money usable within the financial systems customers already rely on today.
By combining Mastercard's global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK's stablecoin infrastructure, we're building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation.
We're a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift.

• Familiarity with database migrations in high-throughput systems.
